title_ar: الوحدة أساس للتحرير .. الشيخ الددو يشارك في قمة علماء المسلمين في كوالالمبور
title_en: “Unity Is the Basis of Liberation” — Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in the Muslim Scholars' Summit in Kuala Lumpur
body_ar:
شارك صباح اليوم الجمعة 20 مايو 2022م فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في افتتاح قمة علماء المسلمين التي تحتضنها العاصمة الماليزية كوالالمبور تحت عنوان:
الوحدة أساس لتحرير فلسطين.
و تنظم القمة بالتعاون بين ماي أقصى الماليزية MyAQSA ومؤسسة الدعوة الإسلامية الماليزية YADIM والاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين والتحالف الدولي لأجل القدس وفلسطين GCQP ،
و تهدف القمة إلى توحيد كلمة المسلمين وآراهم وحثهم على وحدة الصف تحضيرا لمواجهة أعداء الأمة و تحرير مقدساتها
هذا بالإضافة إلى مناقشة قضايا المدينة المقدسة خاصة بعد الاعتداءات المتكررة من الصهاينة

وقد أجمع المجتمعون على وجوب نصرة الأقصى وتحرير فلسطين و دعم أهلها و مؤازرتهم في محنتهم حتى تتحرر الأرض و تستقل البلاد.
و تستمر القمة ثلاثة أيام يناقش فيها المجتمعون قضايا الامة و التحديات التي تواجهها، كيفية نصر فلسطين و تحرير المسجد الأقصى.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew took part this morning, Friday 20 May 2022, in the opening of the Summit of Muslim Scholars hosted by the Malaysian capital, Kuala Lumpur, under the title:
Unity is the basis for the liberation of Palestine.
The summit is organised jointly by the Malaysian MyAQSA, the Malaysian Islamic Call Foundation (YADIM), the International Union of Muslim Scholars, and the Global Coalition for Jerusalem and Palestine (GCQP),
and the summit aims to unite the word of the Muslims and their views, and to urge them to close ranks in preparation for confronting the enemies of the ummah and liberating its sanctuaries,
this in addition to discussing the affairs of the Holy City, particularly after the repeated assaults by the Zionists.

Those assembled were of one accord that supporting al-Aqsa and liberating Palestine, and supporting its people and standing by them in their ordeal until the land is liberated and the country is independent, is obligatory (wujūb).
The summit continues for three days, in which those assembled discuss the affairs of the ummah and the challenges facing it, and how Palestine is to be helped and the Aqsa Mosque liberated.

flags.arabic: وقد أجمع المجتمعون على وجوب نصرة الأقصى وتحرير فلسطين
flags.context: the report's account of what the summit agreed
options: Those assembled were of one accord that ... is obligatory (wujūb)
The assembled scholars reached a consensus (ijmāʿ) on the obligation of ...
The participants agreed that supporting al-Aqsa is a duty
flags.note: Two things must not be lost here. First, this is a news report of what a summit agreed, not a fatwa of the Sheikh: the obligation is attributed to the assembled scholars, and the English keeps that attribution (style guide section 1). Second, أجمع is the verb behind the glossary's ijmāʿ, but a conference resolution is not scholarly consensus in the technical sense, and rendering it 'reached a consensus (ijmāʿ)' would give a summit communiqué the authority of a source of law. 'Were of one accord' has been used for that reason; the flag records the choice.

flags.arabic: الاعتداءات المتكررة من الصهاينة ... وجوب نصرة الأقصى وتحرير فلسطين
flags.context: the report's language about Palestine and Israel
options: publish as translated, with the status banner
hold for review before publication in any jurisdiction
flags.note: editorial_review. The report states as fact that support for al-Aqsa and the liberation of Palestine is religiously obligatory, and uses الصهاينة, 'the Zionists', of the Israeli side. Translated faithfully, neither softened nor strengthened, as style guide section 12 requires. In English this material carries legal and reputational exposure in several Western jurisdictions, and the decision whether and how to publish belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office, never to the translator and never by default.

flags.context: و تهدف القمة إلى توحيد كلمة المسلمين وآراهم
flags.note: Source defect, recorded not fixed: آراهم is written without the hamzah required by آرائهم. body_ar preserves it; the English renders the evident sense. The same record also writes قضايا الامة for الأمة.

translator_notes: This is a news report published by the site, not a text by the Sheikh. Everything it asserts is asserted by the site's news desk, and the only thing attributed to the Sheikh is his attendance.

The CMS date matches the event the body reports ('this morning, Friday 20 May 2022'), so date_is_cms_upload is false for this record. The CMS timestamp is a publication/bulk-upload stamp, not the date on which the Sheikh gave the answer.

Organisation names have been given in English with the source's own Latin-script abbreviations kept as served (MyAQSA, YADIM, GCQP). مؤسسة الدعوة الإسلامية الماليزية is rendered 'the Malaysian Islamic Call Foundation', following the glossary's daʿwah, 'calling people to Islam'; the body's own Latin abbreviation YADIM is retained beside it.

توحيد كلمة المسلمين is the set phrase 'to unite the word of', i.e. to bring to one position. It has deliberately not been rendered with the glossary's tawḥīd, which is the oneness of God and a wholly different matter.
